test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 8 Sept 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Three statements are followed by three conclusions numbered I, II and III. You have to consider these statements to be true, even if they seem to be at variance with commonly known facts. Decide which of the given conclusions logically follow(s) from the given statement.

Statements:

Few melons are bananas

No banana is a cherry

All cherries are litchis

Conclusions:

(I) Some litchis are not bananas

(II) All bananas are melons

(III) All litchis are cherries

options.text: Only conclusion I and III follows

solution:
The least possible Venn diagram for the given statements is as shown below :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b24626c7bf975b343771a5ce837fbec2d47aa3ac259b552cd3ead9a37b14cbda.png] 

Conclusions:

(I) Some litchis are not bananas → Follow (As no banana is a cherry and all cherries are litchis. As Bananas cannot be cherries which whole comes in litchis, therefore it is true.)

(II) All bananas are melons → Does not follow (As few melons are bananas. So it is possible but not definite.)

(III) All litchis are cherries → Does not follow (As all cherries are litchis. So it is possible but not definite.)

∴ Here, Only conclusion I follows.

Hence, "Option 3" is the correct answer.
